extName.message: Reelster — export Reels from Instagram DMs

extDescription.message: Download every Reel and post sent and received in an Instagram DM conversation as a single .tar.gz.

popupHint.message: Open a conversation at instagram.com/direct and click the button.

popupNotThread.message: This tab is not an Instagram DM conversation.

popupExport.message: Export Reels and posts from this conversation

keepOpen.message: Keep this window and the Instagram tab open. The Instagram tab reloads and scrolls by itself to the start of the conversation (or of the period).

stepScan.message: Reading the conversation: $MESSAGES$ messages, $REELS$ Reels, $POSTS$ posts

done.message: Done: $REELS$ Reels and $POSTS$ posts ($FILES$ files), $FAILED$ failed. The download has started.

notLoggedIn.message: You are not logged in to instagram.com in this browser.

noMessages.message: Could not read any message from this conversation. Make sure it is open in the Instagram tab and try again.

periodHint.message: Leave both empty to export the whole conversation. With a start date, reading stops as soon as it reaches that day.

scanHint.message: If the count stops growing, scroll the conversation up yourself in the Instagram tab; everything it loads is captured

listNotFound.message: Could not find the message list to scroll: scroll the conversation up yourself in the Instagram tab

noShares.message: No Reels or posts were found in this conversation (or period).

mediaNotFound.message: media not found (deleted, private account or Instagram changed its format)
